'''Blaster gas canisters''', also known as '''blaster gas cartridges''', were small gas containers used to refill standard [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power packs]]. They held enough [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] for up to 5,000 [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots. Blaster gas canisters were fitted to the power packs, and refilled automatically through a vending port.<ref name="ROE" />
